strings.ix.title: Restaurants und Cafés
strings.ix.heroSum: Ihr Wegweiser zum Essen in Al-Ahsa: ausgewählte Restaurants, Cafés und Bäckereien für „rotes Brot“ in Hofuf, Al-Mubarraz und Umgebung – von Kulturerbe-Ambiente und traditioneller Hausmannskost bis zu modernen Lokalen und Spezialitätenkaffee – jeweils mit Foto und Standort in Google Maps, einen Klick entfernt. Die Liste wächst stetig weiter.
strings.ix.bakeriesNote: Dattelbrot und rotes Brot sind ein und dasselbe – zwei Namen für ein Gericht. Das sind die Bäckereien, in denen dafür der Tanur (Lehmofen) angefeuert wird.
strings.ix.newWindow: (öffnet Google Maps in einem neuen Fenster)
strings.ix.hoursNote: Die Öffnungszeiten stammen von Google Maps und können sich ändern – prüfen Sie sie über den Link zu diesem Ort.
strings.ix.emptyMsg: Keine Treffer – erweitern Sie die Suche oder wählen Sie „Alle Gebiete“.
strings.ix.srcNote: Bewertungen und Öffnungszeiten von Google Maps – zuletzt aktualisiert {date}

termbase_additions.source: Web-verifiziert (Stage 4, 2026-09-19): masculine confirmed two ways — (1) the compound's Grundwort „Kaffee“ is masculine (germanwithlaura.com/kaffee/: „'Kaffee' is der: der Kaffee (the coffee). This means that 'Kaffee' is a masculine noun“), and German compounds take the gender of their final element; (2) attested apposition in running industry text at roastmarket.de/magazin/der-specialty-coffee/: „Der Begriff Spezialitätenkaffee ist zwar kein geschützter Begriff wie etwa Fairtrade“. Term itself (not yet a standalone Duden headword) additionally corroborated as the German coffee trade's stable rendering of „specialty coffee“ by coffeeness.de/specialty-coffee/, cafesito.de/blog/spezialitaeten-kaffee/ and Deutscher Kaffeeverband e. V. usage (kaffeeverband.de) — re-confirmed independently from Stage 3 via WebSearch/WebFetch.

notes: heroSum: en 'traditional food' vs ar 'الأكل الشعبي' (folk/home-style food) - kept close to en ('traditionelle Gerichte'); not reconciled per instructions, flagged for stage 2+.

heroSum: en 'modern spots' vs ar 'المطاعم العصرية' (modern restaurants) - translated 'moderne Lokale' (avoids repeating 'Restaurants' three times in one sentence and avoids Denglisch 'Spots'); fact preserved (modern eating places).

ix.districtLabel/ix.districtAll: chose 'Gebiet'/'Alle Gebiete' rather than reusing det.area='Lage' verbatim - 'Lage' pluralizes awkwardly ('Lagen') for a multi-option dropdown of districts/streets/cities; 'Gebiet' stays a neutral non-administrative term (avoids 'Bezirk') and pluralizes naturally. ix.searchPh echoes the same concept ('Gebiet').

Tanur gloss placement: per gloss_regel the gloss belongs at first running-text occurrence, not a heading/eyebrow - ix.bakeriesEyebrow stays 'Tanur' unglossed, gloss placed in ix.bakeriesNote as 'der Tanur (Lehmofen)' (singular, generic/collective use across the group of bakeries), matching the termbase form exactly.

'rotes Brot' is quoted in „...“ at its first running-text occurrence on the page (ix.heroSum), matching the published /de/food/ dish-card convention; left unquoted afterwards in ix.bakeriesH and ix.bakeriesNote. 'Dattelbrot' appears in ix.bakeriesNote, satisfying the C5b pairing guard on this page.
Added termbase entry for 'Spezialitätenkaffee' (specialty coffee) - no prior termbase entry existed; generic compound noun, gender unambiguous from the head noun 'der Kaffee'.
ix.title = 'Restaurants und Cafés' matches the published nav.dine string verbatim (it serves as H1, breadcrumb label, tab title and ItemList name per pack.json context).

STAGE 2 (editor) — closed translator's open question on heroSum: en 'traditional food' vs ar 'الأكل الشعبي' (folk/home-style, not merely 'traditional'). Replaced 'traditionellen Gerichten' with 'traditioneller Hausmannskost' - a native, idiomatic German noun that carries exactly the home-style/folk connotation ar adds, while 'traditioneller' keeps en's explicit word too. No fact added or dropped, just a more precise register match.
STAGE 2 — fixed a pleonasm in ix.bakeriesNote: stage 1's 'Tanur-Öfen (Lehmöfen)' literally said 'oven-ovens'. Rewrote using the termbase form directly, singular/generic. C5b pairing preserved.
STAGE 2 — ix.hoursNote: 'den Link des Ortes' was a calque of the English possessive; replaced with 'den Link zu diesem Ort'. Same referent, Sie-form kept.
STAGE 2 — ix.heroSum: removed a stacked '–,' before 'jeweils mit Foto…'; a single Halbgeviertstrich already separates the clause, matching the published /de/stay/ heroSum punctuation.

STAGE 2 — verified locked Google Maps strings byte-for-byte unchanged; ix.srcNote tail, ix.moreLabel (no arrow), ix.searchPh (ends in …), ix.emptyMsg quoting, and the Dattelbrot/rotes Brot pairing all re-checked and intact.
STAGE 2 — no Satzklammer, Denglisch, exclamation-mark, or superlative-stacking issues found elsewhere; register, case endings after termbase names and Sie-form usage confirmed correct on review.

STAGE 3 (cultural adapter, DACH) — register check confirmed: 'Hausmannskost' is the right idiomatic match for ar 'الأكل الشعبي' (home-style/folk food, as opposed to fine dining) - it is a warm, native German noun a DACH reader immediately reads as 'honest, everyday cooking', not a literal calque of 'traditional food'. Kept as-is from stage 2.

STAGE 3 — register check confirmed: 'Gebiet' reads naturally as a dropdown filter label for a list of districts/streets/cities (parallel to real-world travel-site filters like 'Bereich'/'Gebiet'), unlike 'Bezirk' (administrative) or 'Lage' (awkward plural, and already carries a different sense — 'location relative to the visitor' — on detail pages). Kept as-is from stage 2.

STAGE 3 — heroSum: changed 'Al-Mubarraz und der Umgebung' to 'Al-Mubarraz und Umgebung'. 'X und Umgebung' (no article) is the standard German toponymic collocation for 'X and its surrounding area' (cf. 'München und Umgebung', 'Rothenburg und Umgebung'); 'und der Umgebung' reads as a translated calque rather than the idiom a DACH reader expects. No fact changed — same three-way list (Hofuf, Al-Mubarraz, surrounding area).

STAGE 3 — considered reordering ix.bakeriesNote to lead with 'Rotes Brot' (matching the en source's exact order and the H2 right above it, which has just introduced 'rotes Brot') — but reverted: the C5b guard's pattern for this pairing is case-sensitive and only matches lowercase 'rot(e|es|er|en|em)? Brot'; putting it at the sentence start forces a capital 'Rotes', which the guard does not recognise as the required pair-member and fails the build (verified by running verify-stage.mjs with the reordered string: 'الزوج «rotes Brot»/«Dattelbrot» معاً (C5b)' failed). Kept stage 2's order 'Dattelbrot und rotes Brot sind ein und dasselbe …', where 'rotes' stays lowercase mid-sentence and the guard passes. No fact, word, or punctuation otherwise changed; the Tanur gloss is untouched.

STAGE 3 — verified via WebSearch that 'Spezialitätenkaffee' is the genuinely stable, in-use German term for specialty coffee (not a stage-2 guess): confirmed across roastmarket.de, coffeeness.de, cafesito.de and in the vocabulary of the Deutscher Kaffeeverband e. V. Updated the termbase_additions source field from 'no web verification possible' to this citation; kept de/artikel/status unchanged since the word itself was already correct.

STAGE 3 — no other fence violations found: nothing added beyond what en/ar state (no visiting hours, no prices, no recommendation, no invented sensory detail). All ten trap items from the brief re-checked and remain satisfied after the two edits above.

STAGE 4 (benchmarker + fact fence) — register benchmark: ix.openNow/ix.closedNow/ix.openFilter („Jetzt geöffnet“ / „Jetzt geschlossen“) match Google Maps' own German badge wording verbatim — the strongest possible benchmark given the data source is Google Maps itself.

STAGE 4 — changed ix.heroEyebrow from „Von den Tischen Al-Ahsas“ to „Von den Tafeln Al-Ahsas“: „Tisch“ is bare furniture and reads as a calque of English „table“; the adjacent published sibling on /de/food/ (nav.food neighbour) renders the same „tables of Al-Ahsa“ figure as „Von der Oasentafel“, i.e. „Tafel“ (a laid/festive table — standard German register for 'cuisine, hospitality'). Switched the head noun to match that register and the sibling page's word choice, kept plural (matching en/ar's plural 'tables'/'موائد', unlike the sibling's singular 'Oasentafel', since this page is not a repeat of that exact string).

STAGE 4 — fact fence restoration in ix.bakeriesNote: en/ar explicitly identify the note as pointing at the bakeries listed below ('these ARE the bakeries whose clay ovens are fired for it' / 'وهذه مخابزُ تُوقد فيها التنانير له'). Stage 3's 'Hier wird dafür der Tanur (Lehmofen) angefeuert' ('here, the Tanur is fired for it') dropped that identifying/pointing clause. Restored it as 'Das sind die Bäckereien, in denen dafür der Tanur (Lehmofen) angefeuert wird' — no new fact added, the dropped clause reinstated; kept the singular collective 'der Tanur' (defensible generic/collective use, avoids inventing a plural form 'Tanure' that has no attested German declension) and did not disturb sentence 1, which still carries the C5b-required 'Dattelbrot'/'rotes Brot' pair.

STAGE 4 — grammar fix in ix.searchPh: 'Nach Name oder Gebiet suchen…' → 'Nach Namen oder Gebiet suchen…'. 'Name' is an n-declension noun (der Name, des Namens, dem/den Namen); the preposition 'nach' governs the dative, so the dative singular must be 'Namen', not the bare nominative form 'Name'. This was a real grammar error, not a style choice.

STAGE 4 — clarity fix in ix.hoursNote: 'prüfen Sie den Link zu diesem Ort' ('check the link') is ambiguous — it reads as verifying that the link itself works, not as 'use the link to verify the hours', which is what en/ar mean ('check the place's link' = look the current hours up there). Added the object 'sie' (referring back to 'Die Öffnungszeiten') and 'über': 'prüfen Sie sie über den Link zu diesem Ort.' No fact changed, same referent (the card's Google Maps link), Sie-form kept.

STAGE 4 — fact-fence re-audit of all 32 strings against en and ar: no unsupported facts, numbers, superlatives, quality judgements ('beste/empfehlenswert/köstlich/berühmt' etc.) or recommendations found beyond what Stage 2/3 already removed. 'stetig' in ix.heroSum ('Die Liste wächst stetig weiter') is not an invented embellishment: it reflects ar's 'تباعاً' (successively/gradually), which en's plain 'keeps growing' does not carry explicitly — ar is authority per the brief's fact-fence rule, so kept. No other fence violations found; nothing further removed this stage.

STAGE 4 — verified all four LOCKED Google Maps strings (ix.newWindow, ix.ratingLabel, ix.closedPerm, ix.closedTemp) byte-for-byte against context.published_stay_de_do_not_edit — unchanged from Stage 3, all match.

STAGE 4 — verified ix.moreLabel ('Details zum Ort') and ix.listEyebrow ('Die erste Gruppe') match their published /de/stay/ siblings verbatim as instructed; ix.title ('Restaurants und Cafés') matches published nav.dine verbatim; ix.srcNote tail ('– zuletzt aktualisiert {date}') matches the locked ending exactly, extended only with 'und Öffnungszeiten' as instructed.

STAGE 4 — termbase: re-verified 'der Spezialitätenkaffee' (specialty coffee) independently via WebSearch/WebFetch and added a verbatim gender witness with URL (see stage_specific.gender_witnesses) — the term was already added correctly at Stage 3 but lacked a witness quote in the format this stage requires. No wording change.

STAGE 4 — Denglisch check: no 'Event(s)/Spot(s)/Location/Must-see/Hotspot/Guide/Highlight' found. Punctuation check: all em-dash positions use U+2013 (never U+2014), ix.searchPh ends in a single U+2026 ellipsis, quotation marks use „…“ (U+201E/U+201C) throughout, no straight quotes, no U+00A0. Sie-form confirmed consistent (no 'du' forms). 'Souk' not 'Souq' — not applicable this batch (term not used).

STAGE 5 (proofreader) — full mechanical pass over all 32 strings against the ten-item checklist; no wording changes required, all items PASS. Re-verified byte-for-byte the four LOCKED Google Maps strings (ix.newWindow, ix.ratingLabel, ix.closedPerm, ix.closedTemp) against context.published_stay_de_do_not_edit, plus ix.moreLabel/ix.listEyebrow (published /de/stay/ siblings), ix.title (published nav.dine) and the ix.srcNote locked tail — all identical.

STAGE 5 — re-checked the C5b pair: 'Dattelbrot' and 'rotes Brot' both present on the page (ix.heroSum quotes „rotes Brot“ at first running-text mention; ix.bakeriesH/ix.bakeriesNote use it unquoted thereafter; ix.bakeriesNote names 'Dattelbrot'). Guard satisfied.

STAGE 5 — re-checked Tanur glossing: 'Tanur' unglossed in the eyebrow (ix.bakeriesEyebrow, a heading-level element) and glossed once as 'der Tanur (Lehmofen)' at its first running-text occurrence (ix.bakeriesNote) — matches gloss_regel exactly, no double-glossing.

STAGE 5 — verified case government and endings across every preposition phrase (zum Essen, für „rotes Brot“, in Hofuf/Al-Mubarraz und Umgebung, von Kulturerbe-Ambiente/traditioneller Hausmannskost, bis zu modernen Lokalen/Spezialitätenkaffee, mit Foto und Standort, aus dem Tanur, über den Link zu diesem Ort, von Google Maps, nach Namen/nach Art) and genitive 'Al-Ahsas' in ix.heroEyebrow — all correct, no ending errors found.

STAGE 5 — verified no Duden ß is missing or misused (no Straße/größte/heiß-type words in this batch), all noun capitalization and compound spelling correct (Bäckereien, Kaffeeliebhaber, Spezialitätenkaffee, Kulturerbe-Ambiente, Hausmannskost, Öffnungszeiten), Durchkopplung correct where applicable, no pleonasm.
STAGE 5 — Anrede re-checked: 'Ihr' (ix.heroSum) and 'Sie' (ix.hoursNote, ix.emptyMsg) capitalized and consistent; zero 'du/dein' occurrences anywhere in the 32 strings.
STAGE 5 — verified key order and count: all 32 pack.json keys present in de-05.json 'strings' in the exact pack.json order, byte-identical field names.

checklist.title: Rechtschreibung (Duden, de-DE)
checklist.detail: No ß-eligible words in this batch (no Straße/größte/heiß-type forms) so nothing to correct there; umlauts correct throughout (Bäckereien, Öffnungszeiten, geöffnet, geschlossen, wächst); noun capitalization correct in all 32 strings including inside the long heroSum sentence; compounds written correctly as single words or hyphenated per convention (Kaffeeliebhaber, Spezialitätenkaffee, Hausmannskost, Kulturerbe-Ambiente) — no illegally split compounds found.

checklist.title: Durchkopplung
checklist.detail: No proper-noun+generic-word compound in this batch needed a new hyphen decision (no Souk/Moschee/See names here). 'Kulturerbe-Ambiente' correctly hyphenated, matching the already-published pattern 'Kulturerbe-Gasthaus'/'Kulturerbe-Hotel'. No pleonasm (no 'Tanur-Ofen', no 'Souk-Markt').

checklist.title: Grammatik
checklist.detail: Checked every preposition + case pair (zum Essen [dat.], für „rotes Brot“ [neut. acc. strong -es], in Hofuf/Al-Mubarraz und Umgebung, von Kulturerbe-Ambiente/traditioneller Hausmannskost [fem. dat. strong -er], bis zu modernen Lokalen [pl. dat. -en/-en], mit Foto und Standort, aus dem Tanur [masc. dat.], über den Link [acc.] zu diesem Ort [dat.], von Google Maps, nach Namen [n-declension dative] / nach Art) — all case endings correct. Genitive 'Al-Ahsas' (no apostrophe) in ix.heroEyebrow matches the site's established genitive pattern. Satzklammer closed correctly in 'wächst … weiter' and the passive relative clause 'in denen … angefeuert wird'. No gender/artikel mismatches against the termbase.

checklist.title: Anrede
checklist.detail: 'Ihr' (ix.heroSum) and 'Sie' (ix.hoursNote, ix.emptyMsg) capitalized correctly; zero 'du'/'dein' occurrences anywhere in the 32 strings.

checklist.title: Termbase compliance
checklist.detail: der Tanur (Lehmofen) — correct form and gloss placement; Dattelbrot/rotes Brot — C5b pair present together on the page; Al-Ahsa/Hofuf/Al-Mubarraz — spelled and de-articled exactly per termbase and site precedent; Google Maps — artikellos, correct prepositions (in Google Maps for the opening location, von Google Maps for data attribution, matching the published /de/stay/ srcNote pattern); der Spezialitätenkaffee — new termbase entry, gender witnessed with URL, carried forward unchanged. No violation found; nothing to fix.

checklist.title: Interpunktion
checklist.detail: All parenthetical dashes are spaced Halbgeviertstriche (U+2013) — heroSum (×2), bakeriesNote, hoursNote, emptyMsg, and the three LOCKED Google Maps lines; „…“ quotation marks used for „rotes Brot“ and „Alle Gebiete“ (matching ix.districtAll verbatim inside ix.emptyMsg); ix.searchPh ends in a single … ellipsis; no serial comma before 'und' in the 'Restaurants, Cafés und Bäckereien' list; comma correctly placed before the relative clause in ix.bakeriesNote ('…Bäckereien, in denen…').

checklist.title: Zahlen, Datum, Währung, Hidschra
checklist.detail: No literal numbers, dates, currency or Hijri dates in this batch (index-frame strings only). Placeholders {n} and {date} each occur exactly once, in ix.countSuffix and ix.srcNote respectively, and are unmodified — Western digits/placeholder syntax intact.

checklist.title: Denglisch
checklist.detail: Zero occurrences of Event(s)/Spot(s)/Location/Must-see/Hotspot/Guide anywhere; 'modern spots' was rendered 'moderne Lokale', not 'Spots'; 'Area' was rendered 'Gebiet', not 'Location'. 'Highlight' does not occur at all (well within the ≤1 allowance).

checklist.title: Glossierung
checklist.detail: 'Tanur' is glossed exactly once, at its first running-text occurrence (ix.bakeriesNote: 'der Tanur (Lehmofen)'), and left unglossed in the heading-level ix.bakeriesEyebrow — correct per gloss_regel (gloss belongs in running text, not a heading).

checklist.title: Struktur
checklist.detail: All 32 pack.json keys present in de-05.json in the exact pack.json order, field names byte-identical (ix.* dot-paths unchanged). No frontmatter/links/image paths in this batch (pure UI strings). ix.heroSum doubles as the meta description per pack.json context and follows the same fact-fence and language rules as the rendered lead paragraph — verified identical single string used for both.
